description: This file sets up an asynchronous pipeline for a conversational AI system using various services (STT, TTS, LLM, transport) and event handlers for client connection events.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: A smart turn analyzer used in user turn strategies.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on Silero models.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame used to trigger LLM processing in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversation pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a task with a pipeline and parameters.

classes.name: HeyGenTransport
classes.description: Transport layer for HeyGen API interactions.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to determine when a user turn should stop.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that sets up and runs the conversation pipeline.

methods.name: on_client_connected
methods.description: Event handler for client connection, initiates conversation.

methods.name: on_client_disconnected
methods.description: Event handler for client disconnection, cancels ongoing tasks.
